notes.title: VectorBall
notes.content:
Today marks the release of VectorBall in Early Access.
It's been a long road getting to this point, but we don't plan on stopping anytime soon.

[url=https://discord.gg/sXX2Tcj]Click here to join our Discord server[/url] to keep up to date with our development and give us feedback. Multiplayer servers may be relatively empty at first, so come join the Discord chat and challenge us to a match.

We have a long list of features we plan to add to the game in the near future, along with general improvements/bug fixes. 

[b]New Maps and Game modes[/b]
There's a sneak preview of our next map on the Discord chat. We'd love to hear your suggestions for new multiplayer modes and features as well.

[b]More Single Player and Co-Op content[/b]
We're exploring adding a roguelike co-op mode, vs enemy bots. We have many ideas for new content, and would love to talk to you to hear your thoughts.

[b]AI SPEECH MODULE[/b]
[strike]REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED[/strike]

We hope you enjoy our initial Early Access release, thank you for your support. We're looking 
forward to improving VectorBall and building the community further. 

Challenge us to a match if you want to prove your skill.

-Director
